name: Photo Synth
description: Play four photos: colour becomes tone — mono/unison (1-12 stacked voices) or true 4-note polyphony with 1-4 oscillators per note — plus filter, envelope (to amplitude, filter sweep or both) and an FX photo whose red/green/blue strengths drive three chosen effects. Six switchable stereo FX: tube, vintage phaser, vintage chorus, stutter, clean/tape delay, reverb. On-device presets with photo snapshots and file export, motion automation, live camera, MIDI chords, 24-bit WAV export.
note: On iPhone, sound follows the ring/silent switch.
